item.title: HBCU Tailgate Inspiration – Lowcountry Style - BSB MEDIA
item.description: HBCU Tailgate season is right around the corner. As a proud Howard University alum, I can't wait and am already having dreams about tailgate fun but unfortunately, with a newborn, I won't be leaving for DC any time soon. If you are like me and a new parent, busy at a new job or saving for a home and can't make it back to your homecoming to tailgate, don't let that stop your fun.
